hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/(npm run build|pnpm build|yarn build)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Build completed - async analysis running in background')}}catch{}console.log(d)})"
